native_policy_reviewed.configuration: Source lossy=true/fullmetadata=true/accuracy0.0001 defaults; initialized batch500; finite nonpositive accuracy preserves ordinary fixed-point sentinel; atomic config validation.
native_policy_reviewed.selection: Nonempty unique nonnegative i64 SQL IDs, ascendingID results; empty RT restriction selects all. Nonpositive RT delta picks earliest qualifyingRT thenID.
native_policy_reviewed.errors: SQLite Error::Io retaining cause; malformed input checked errors; unsupported metadata Error::Unsupported.
native_policy_reviewed.metadata: Full snapshot uses native mzML subset; auxiliary arrays defaultReject or explicitSource drop; peptide IDs and unsupported mzML fields still fail; SQL-only metadata loss requires Source policy.
native_policy_reviewed.transactions: One read transaction per public operation; atomic writes, counters aftercommit; builder run snapshot can precede records and is validated at read.
native_policy_reviewed.numeric: Compression1/5/6; raw little-endianf64; finite checked f32 intensities; distinct paired roles and lengths.
native_policy_reviewed.limits: ID/result vectors, metadata copies, snapshot record slots, codec work, and nested parameter/array allowances charged to operation budgets. Fixed ordinary-table schema checks before reads/writes and before each commit; create_tables validates staged database. Nested mzML header registry retains independent256MiB/50million fixed limits; no hard SQLite VM time or totalRSS guarantee.
native_policy_reviewed.short_coordinates: Lossy mode uses code1 for fewer than3coordinates. Longer arrays reject nonfinite/nonpositive Numpress factors and initial2coordinates outsideu32 quantization; caller can select lossless mode for these finite inputs.
native_policy_reviewed.run_id_owner: Dedicated MSExperiment.sql_run_id; pairedmzML fixture settings comparison removes legacy sqMassRunID metadata key from expectation.
native_policy_reviewed.parallelism: Pinned C++ uses OpenMP in spectrum/chromatogram array encoding; native handler serial. SQL batching is retained; each native public write has one transaction.
native_policy_reviewed.ordinary_table_guard: Parameterized pragma_table_list() queries reject required views/virtual tables; a shadowing ordinary table named pragma_table_list causes query failure rather than forged-table acceptance.

functions.name: optimalLinearFixedPointMass
functions.behavior: Returns zero for dataSize<3, based on incorrect comment that first two points are encoded as floats.

functions.name: encodeLinear
functions.behavior: First and second values are integer-quantized by fixedPoint, so factor0 discards finite coordinates.

functions.name: decodeLinear
functions.behavior: Divides integer0 by fixedPoint0, producing NaN for each short coordinate.

source_defect.proposed_cpp_fix: For nonempty one/two-value arrays, select a positive finite factor that meets requested accuracy and first-value integer range, rather than zero. Reject nonfinite/zero factors for nonempty raw linear encoding/decoding. Handle all-zero arrays explicitly; ordinary optimalLinearFixedPoint returns infinity for length1/2 and is not by itself a safe fallback. No upstream patch applied.

short_numpress_cpp_probe.native_handler_guidance: Explicit lossless code1 for all short coordinate arrays avoids both defects, including zeros and empty arrays, while preserving source-reader supported encodings. Source intensity SLOF need not change. Explicit factor1 zero controls also round-trip, but general lossless fallback is simpler and does not alter public raw-codec source semantics.
short_numpress_cpp_probe.main_probe_cases: results.jsonl includes42 cases: requested accuracy and ordinary estimate for9 arrays at2 accuracies, plus6 explicit factor1 zero controls. Ordinary nonfinite factors are recorded and encoding skipped.

additional_diagnostic.description: A separate sanitizer-only run completed before the integrating agent asked to skip nonfinite encoding entirely. It intentionally calls exact encodeLinear with the infinite ordinary zero estimate and halts on float-cast-overflow at source326. This diagnostic is retained honestly but no resulting encoded/decoded value is used, and it is not needed for the factor0->NaN conclusion.
additional_diagnostic.result: Sanitizer caught NaN outside representable long long range; no further execution of this path.
